canonical_inputs.claim_adjudication: Lie Ledger / Claims Forensics may be consumed as read-only factual context; it is not authoritative over WOL-native incident qualification, source-behavior metrics, awards, Hall placement, or direct verdicts.

exclusive_wol_authority.rule: No external Atlas lane may grant, deny, suppress, override, or require a WOL-native incident, behavior metric, source award, Hall result, or direct verdict. Other lanes may provide evidence or canonical factual context only.

authority.canonical_non_overwrite_rule: WOL does not overwrite canonical Evidence/Lie-Ledger fields when making WOL-native findings. Non-overwrite is a storage/authority boundary, not a veto over WOL's own adjudication.

media_analysis_review.rule: Adverse WOL scoring is controlled by WOL's own evidentiary gate. Upstream Evidence/Lie-Ledger review may be requested for canonical synchronization but cannot grant, deny, delay, or override a WOL-native incident or award.

BULLSHITTER.description: Repeatedly publishes false/materially misleading factual claims or presents unsupported factual assertions, inferential bridges, or self-sealing evasions as established fact.
BULLSHITTER.evidence_rule: Receipts first. False/materially misleading incidents qualify when established. Unsupported asserted facts/bridges qualify when a documented public-evidence search finds no support and records the search scope and claimant basis. Mere inability to disprove a claim is insufficient.

unsupported_evidence_gate.rule: A positive factual assertion carries its own evidentiary burden. WOL may find it unsupported without proving the logical opposite, but may not convert incomplete/inaccessible evidence into an unsupported finding.

BULLSHITTER.amplification_counts_as_source_conduct_w: A downstream publisher/account republishes, repeats, embeds, quotes approvingly, or otherwise adopts a WOL-qualified false/materially misleading claim as factual. The upstream claim is not re-adjudicated; the downstream publication receipt establishes the amplifier's own conduct. Neutral attributed reporting with meaningful corrective context does not count.
BULLSHITTER.self_amplification_rule: A source may be both Bullshitter and amplifier. When a publisher/account propagates its own WOL-qualified bullshit through another publication, platform account, repost, embed, or syndication surface, record a SELF_AMPLIFICATION edge. Self-amplification does not create a second Bullshitter incident unless there is a distinct downstream publication event after ordinary same-information-event deduplication.

network_assisted_qualification.rule: Network topology may contribute to Bullshitter qualification when the node itself repeatedly publishes qualifying bullshit amplification. A node with receipt-backed qualifying amplification from at least 5 distinct upstream WOL Bullshitters/qualifying bullshit amplifiers and at least 6 distinct qualifying amplification publications satisfies the network-assisted Bullshitter route. Ten or more distinct upstream WOL nodes is a high-density hub signal. Mere follows, mentions, replies, ideological affinity, shared audience, or other social adjacency never count; the target node's own publication conduct remains mandatory. No time window applies.
network_assisted_qualification.current_runtime_upstream_basis: ROOT_BULLSHITTER_EVENT; preserve immediate qualifying amplifier when recoverable

source_discovery_scope.active_corpus_rule: Active Web-of-Lies source-behavior discovery is limited to publishers or amplifiers materially participating in factual or analytical claims about the 2026 Iran war. General misinformation history, unrelated regional propaganda, and pre-2026 claim behavior outside this conflict are out of scope and must not be retained in the active corpus merely to characterize a source.
source_discovery_scope.materiality_rule: For non-official/non-canonical claim-first source discovery, Iran-war relevance is necessary but not sufficient. Retain a publisher only when public receipts establish either a large direct audience/reach or documented downstream amplification into a materially influential Iran-war information network. A seed account with no material 2026 Iran-war activity is removed from the active adjudication queue.
source_discovery_scope.reach_is_intake_only: Follower/subscriber/view/repost evidence may establish source-selection materiality. It must not determine truth, deception, Bullshitter qualification, Hall-of-Shame score, or credibility.
source_discovery_scope.amplification_intake_rule: A smaller source may qualify when public evidence shows its Iran-war claims are materially amplified by other publishers/accounts or move through an established amplification network.
source_discovery_scope.amplifier_behavior_rule: Amplification is recorded as receipt-backed propagation evidence under the WOL-qualified source/claim that was amplified. The upstream truth finding is reused rather than re-adjudicated. The amplifier-specific publication is also the amplifier's own source behavior: when it republishes/repeats/embeds/quotes approvingly/adopts the qualifying false or materially misleading proposition as factual, that publication may qualify toward the amplifier's own Bullshitter history. Preserve amplifier identity, publication receipt, platform, immediate upstream node when recoverable, and root Bullshitter/incident lineage.
source_discovery_scope.no_guilt_by_network_rule: Network membership alone proves nothing. A megaphone edge requires a proved publication, repost, repeat, embed, or adoption of the specific qualifying message. Neutral attributed reporting with meaningful corrective context is not a megaphone edge.
source_discovery_scope.parody_rule: Accounts explicitly presented as parody/satire are excluded from WOL factual-behavior adjudication and Bullshitter-award accumulation. Historical network membership/provenance may be retained only when it is part of a material 2026 Iran-war propagation chain; parody accounts are not active adjudication targets.
source_discovery_scope.inaccessible_relevant_content_rule: When material 2026 Iran-war content is known to exist but the evidentiary body is inaccessible behind a paywall or equivalent access barrier, use an unable-to-adjudicate disposition. Do not convert inaccessible content into a clean/no-adverse finding.
source_discovery_scope.ai_assistance_rule: Use of AI is not itself adverse behavior. Score the published factual proposition, inferential bridge or evidentiary presentation. Record AI-assisted authorship only when independently evidenced and material to provenance.
source_discovery_scope.inference_rule: Repeated analytical overfitting can qualify when the publication presents a causal, control, motive, intent or strategic conclusion as established fact and the preserved evidence does not support that bridge. Mere disagreement or an unresolved inference does not qualify.
source_discovery_scope.self_amplification_rule: Publishers/accounts may simultaneously be Bullshitters and amplifiers. Publisher-owned reposts, mirrors, embeds, cross-platform syndication, and other propagation of the publisher's own WOL-qualified bullshit are recorded as SELF_AMPLIFICATION rather than discarded as publisher plumbing.
source_discovery_scope.network_pattern_rule: Receipt-backed propagation topology is behavioral evidence. Five or more distinct upstream WOL Bullshitter/qualifying-amplifier nodes is a systematic-network signal; ten or more is a high-density hub signal. Only publication/repost/repeat/embed/adoption edges count. Follows, mentions, replies, ideology, organizational proximity, or shared audiences do not.
source_discovery_scope.network_assisted_bullshitter_rule: Network position may assist Bullshitter qualification only when paired with the node's own qualifying publication conduct under source_awards.BULLSHITTER.network_assisted_qualification. Six distinct qualifying incidents are cumulative; no time window applies. Network adjacency by itself cannot confer an award.

FAKE_ANALYST.rule: The source must publicly claim an analyst role. After the Bullshitter award is independently earned, at least three distinct qualifying WOL incidents must document unsupported analytical bridges, inference presented as fact, or verification failures in analysis. A profile claim or monetization alone can never trigger this label.

YELLOW_JOURNALISM.rule: The source must publicly claim a journalist role. After the Bullshitter award is independently earned, at least three distinct qualifying WOL incidents must document basic journalistic verification failures and at least two must document sensationalized or materially distorted presentation. A profile claim or monetization alone can never trigger this label.
